mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, a completed four-hour BTC close returning inside a canonical twenty-period two-standard-deviation Bollinger Band after an outside close marks a statistically normalized price excursion beginning to mean revert; follow the inward re-entry direction for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long when close crosses strictly above the lower band after being at or below it; short when close crosses strictly below the upper band after being at or above it
mechanism.why_distinct: HVBB uses a contemporaneous twenty-close mean and population dispersion envelope, unlike ATR channels, extrema channels, oscillators, recursive SAR, volume, OI, funding, premium, or Gross9 states. Prior repository Bollinger usage was a feature/veto in another selected system, not this standalone frozen event clock.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%; the two-standard-deviation excursion then identifies relative overextension inside that volatile regime
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse four-hour dispersion-band re-entry clocks are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T)
features.center: simple mean of exactly 20 consecutive completed four-hour closes including current
features.dispersion: population standard deviation ddof=0 of the same 20 closes
features.bands: center plus/minus exactly 2*dispersion; zero dispersion invalid
features.reentry: current close strictly crosses inward through its current lower/upper band from prior close at or outside the corresponding prior band
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed five-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: canonical standalone Bollinger inward re-entry under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no window, center, ddof, multiplier, formula, crossing, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, or control repair.

external_basis.fixed_definition: 20 completed closes; simple moving average center; population standard deviation; upper/lower bands at center plus/minus 2 standard deviations; inward re-entry direction
external_basis.selection_use: published period, center, dispersion multiplier, and direction only; no incidence or outcomes
